Chapter 1188: Chapter 9 Preaching (Request for Subscription)_2

Lin Yuan spoke up.

The more beings that cultivate the Martial Arts Evolution Road, the more stable Lin Yuan’s anchor point and guidepost become, so naturally, he doesn’t want the spread of Martial Tao to be limited to a certain area.

"No problem."

The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country agreed without a second thought.

This matter bears no loss, and as for non-royal beings benefiting from it? If their bloodline reaches the royal level, then they become part of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s royalty.

"Galaxy, if your method indeed proves effective, your credit will surely be substantial."

The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country stated solemnly.

"Mm."

Lin Yuan nodded. Disseminating his own Martial Arts Evolution Road branch inherently aids his breakthrough in the cycle of time, so he would proceed even without credit.

Of course, having credit is preferable.

"I estimate a period needed to prepare."

Lin Yuan said. The rules and avenues of this source world operate entirely differently from the Chaos Void, so the Martial Arts Evolution Road branch needs significant adjustments to fully adapt to this world.

Especially since Lin Yuan plans to ’do as the Romans do,’ enhancing the excavation of potential within bloodlines in his Martial Arts Evolution Road branch, to better fit this world.

"Alright."

The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country seemed to recall something, "Regarding Jihan Heavenly Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage..."

"These are their personal weapons and arms." Lin Yuan immediately took out several weapons and arms, to prove he had thoroughly left the main combat bodies of these two Heavenly Venerates.

"All right."

The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country glanced over, "One million credits have been awarded to you."

"Thank you."

Lin Yuan said.

In his mind, he pondered over which treasures and rare inheritances he should exchange from the treasury.

Last time he spent a long time in the treasury, but only had over ten thousand credits, in the end only able to exchange for three Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams.

"About the two Heavenly Venerates infiltrating Hei Yu Nest, I will demand an explanation from Xuanyin Ancient Country." The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country said to Lin Yuan with a smile, "If there are any benefits at that time, they can also count as your credit."

Lin Yuan smiled upon hearing this.

Sneaking in against unwritten rules, and taking action without permission, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country holds them accountable, Xuanyin Ancient Country is sure to appease and make concessions.

How to appease and make concessions?

Naturally through benefits and concessions.

This means, the benefits obtained by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country are partly due to Lin Yuan, who can naturally claim corresponding credit.

...

After leaving the palace.

Lin Yuan immediately headed to the treasury.

With one million credits in hand, it is only natural to quickly convert it into his own strength.

While browsing the treasury last time, Lin Yuan had his eye on several treasures, rare inheritances.

But ultimately was limited by insufficient credits, and at that time, understanding Chaos Rule was most urgent.

So he finally chose three Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams.

Now with a million credits, his choices are naturally much broader.

...

Xuanyin Ancient Country, the capital,

Within a vast and grand hall, the emperor sat on the throne, while below him, figures stood or sat.

Those present in this hall were at least various major kings, or the ultimate core royalty, or were Heavenly Venerates.

In various ancient countries, although emperors wielded all power, they still showed sufficient respect in the presence of Heavenly Venerate level experts.

"Jihan, Beiyin."

The emperor of Xuanyin Ancient Country spoke, his eyes vaguely reflecting the full moon, gazing down at the two figures standing below.

"Explain to us, what happened with the Hei Yu Nest?"

The tone of the emperor of Xuanyin Ancient Country was steady, but below, the expressions of the various Heavenly Venerates slightly changed.

The emperor clearly held dissatisfaction towards the actions of Jihan Heavenly Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage, and revealing such an attitude in the presence of so many Heavenly Venerates meant that these two had committed a major offense.

"We..."

Jihan Heavenly Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage exchanged a look. After things fell through with Lin Yuan, they had reported everything to the emperor.

The emperor of Xuanyin Ancient Country told them to wait and see how the Fierce Sun Ancient Country would proceed.

It now seems the Fierce Sun Ancient Country must be putting substantial pressure on the emperor.

"I and Jihan sneaked into Hei Yu Nest without permission, resulting in our main combat bodies being left behind by the guardian..." Beiyin Venerable Sage sighed inwardly, knowing there was no escaping punishment.

"Infiltrate Hei Yu Nest?"

"Left behind the main combat body?"

The Heavenly Venerates and the ultimate core royal family present twitched their facial muscles.

With Heavenly Venerate level combat power, to act on a top treasure ground without permission and being caught on the spot, it’s no wonder the emperor has such a poor attitude towards the two Heavenly Venerates.

"Jihan, Beiyin, you acted impulsively. Hei Yu Nest is a top treasure ground, and you dared to infiltrate it at will?" A burly Heavenly Venerate spoke up.

He didn’t even ask why Jihan and Beiyin infiltrated Hei Yu Nest.

If he had the opportunity, he too would like to sneak in, given that the rare Hei Yu is a great treasure, even if he couldn’t use it himself, he could exchange it with other Heavenly Venerates for needed rare treasures.

"I recall that the guardian of Hei Yu Nest changed not long ago, Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate was reassigned, and Galaxy Great Lord took over?"

A man with a dark, gentle expression suddenly spoke, looking at Jihan Heavenly Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage, "Galaxy Great Lord is not a Heavenly Venerate, what means did he use to leave your main combat bodies behind?"

Jihan Heavenly Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage remained silent.

Sitting high on the throne, the emperor of Xuanyin Ancient Country spoke, "This is the second matter today, that Galaxy Great Lord may have already excavated his ancestral bloodline to the Heavenly Venerate level."

With these words.

The hall fell silent.

The Heavenly Venerates’ expressions slightly shifted, and even more so the core royal family members.

Excavating a bloodline to the Heavenly Venerate level is unprecedented in the six ancient countries’ history.

"Jihan, Beiyin, are you sure, that Galaxy can leave your main combat bodies, definitely indicates combat power at the Heavenly Venerate level, but whether this power arises from ancestral bloodline or another aspect..."

Another ancient Heavenly Venerate asked.

The royal families of the various ancient countries do indeed have Heavenly Venerate level combat power, but the Heavenly Venerate here refers to those who have realized the second level of the chaos evolutionary force road.

This is different from other Heavenly Venerates, who have excavated ancestral bloodlines to the Heavenly Venerate level.

There is a fundamental difference between the two.

"The methods and abilities that Galaxy utilized had no traces of chaos evolutionary force."

Beiyin Venerable Sage spoke up.

As a Heavenly Venerate, he could distinguish this.

"Did he not use any external objects, perhaps a secret treasure weapon left by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s ancestors?"

Another Heavenly Venerate asked.

"No." Jihan Heavenly Venerate shook his head, "Hei Yu Nest is located at the border, how could the emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country possibly place such a critical treasure here?"

Any external object allowing a Great Lord to exert Heavenly Venerate combat power would undoubtedly be considered a foundational secret treasure weapon. Even if granted to Galaxy Great Lord, it’s meant for life-saving for the main body, not a border-positioned avatar? It would be too risky.

...

After extensive inquiry and discussion, most Heavenly Venerates at the scene confirmed that Galaxy Great Lord had indeed excavated his bloodline to the Heavenly Venerate level.

Jihan Heavenly Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage felt bitter, facing inquiries from numerous Heavenly Venerates, they could only answer truthfully, not daring to show the slightest dissatisfaction.

This matter was indeed their initial wrongdoing; acting secretly on a Heavenly Venerate level, in general remaining undiscovered leads to no repercussions.

However, as their main combat bodies were left behind, and their personal weapons could serve as evidence, they found it hard to avoid punishment.

Sneaking into Hei Yu Nest?"

"Getting their main combat body left behind?"

Mouths twitched among the Heavenly Venerates and ultimate core royalty present.

"Jihan and Beiyin, you were too impulsive, Hei Yu Nest is a top treasure ground, yet you dared to sneak in there?" A massive-built Heavenly Venerate spoke.

He did not question why Jihan and Beiyin trespassed into Hei Yu Nest.

If he had such qualifications, he would also wish to sneak in. After all, the special treasure Hei Yu is a great treasure, even if he doesn’t need it, it can still be exchanged with other Heavenly Venerates for desirable treasures.

"I remember that Hei Yu Nest recently changed its guardian, Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate was transferred, and Galaxy Great Lord took over?"

A man with a gentle expression suddenly spoke, looking at Jihan Heavenly Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage, "Galaxy Great Lord is not a Heavenly Venerate, how did he manage to leave your main combat bodies behind?"

Jihan Heavenly Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage did not answer.

Sitting up high on his throne, the emperor of Xuanyin Ancient Country said, "This is the second matter of today, that Galaxy Great Lord, it seems, has already excavated his ancestral bloodline to the Heavenly Venerate level."

As these words were spoken,

The hall immediately fell silent.

The facial expressions of the many Heavenly Venerates changed slightly, and even more so the core royal family members.

Excavating the bloodline to the Heavenly Venerate level is supposed to be just above Peak Venerable at best.

It’s not an unmanageable existence.

Despite the endless years of conflict between the two ancient countries, having a few more Peak Venerables does not determine the overall outcome of the battle.

A single Galaxy Venerate cannot sway the balance of the two great ancient countries.
